subject: Improve unit testing cmake infrastructure (#238)
reason: The change only restructures the unit-test CMake build (consolidating per-file test executables into six suite executables, splitting testing_common into testing_common_base and testing_common_coordinator, and deleting the absorbed testing/coordinator, testing/query and testing/utils CMakeLists files) and renames the MaxLimitTest test class in testing/ft_search_test.cc to FTSearchMaxLimitTest to avoid a name collision in the consolidated suite.
